tech1.title: Data Center Infrastructure
tech1.desc: The facilities required to build a data center.
tech1.intro: Servers used for AI computing consume a great deal of power and generate a great deal of heat. LUA develops the facilities that supply that power and handle that heat, designed so that heat is recovered and reused rather than discarded.

sections.title: Applications
body: Small-scale data centers in areas with limited grid capacity

tech2.title: Data Center Operations
tech2.desc: Managing power, cooling, and computing together.
tech2.intro: In a data center, power, cooling, and computing all affect one another. LUA develops operating technology that evaluates and adjusts them together rather than separately, and records equipment condition and usage history so it can also support asset management.

sections.title: Platform Overview
body: Integrated operation of power, cooling, and computing
Recording of equipment condition and usage history
